the second way of looking at economy is to look at labor and raw materials (as well as means of production which can include land, infrastructure, machines and the like but production and raw material are the two most important parts in this view). economy is the movement of raw materials to labor to be formed into goods that are then dispersed to people. looking at what is made where from materials that came from where and are then distributed to whom is highly meaningful and perhaps more important than the money aspect of economy.
